note: Cherokee National Forest campground in a mountain cove along Paint Creek, a stocked trout stream, with widely spaced sites screened by rhododendron and hemlock; the Paint Mountain and Paint Creek trails start nearby. Five people and two vehicles per site. --Claude
summary: Cherokee NF first-come campground, 20 sites (17 drive-in nonelectric, 3 tent-only), $10, vault toilets, season May-Oct (2027: 05-07 to 10-24 on rec.gov). CLOSED for the 2026 season for access-road damage. Stored riverview not supported by the site photos: proposed down to not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (default-down): stored 'riverview' -> 'not waterfront'. Paint Creek here is a creek (well under 30 m), so the on-water value would be creekside; nothing earns it - the imagery is canopy-blind, and the rec.gov preview photos (May, leaf-on) of the six 'Riverfront'-tagged RV sites 3, 4, 7, 9, 10, 11 show pads backed by forest and rhododendron with no water in sight. The only view basis is the agency prose ('streamside views and are well screened with native vegetation'), which can't stand alone, and rec.gov's 'Riverfront' site tags are known to be loose. After every source the view is unconfirmed, so it goes down. If the reviewer prefers to hold the view on the agency wording, 'riverview' is the ceiling (screened = view, never creekside).

STATUS: FS page 'Site Closed' - 'closed for the 2026 season due to extensive road damage leading to the campground' (written as temporarily_closed, no reopening date announced; rec.gov still carries a 2027 season 05-07 to 10-24 and is not deactivated). Re-check before the 2027 season.

ACCESS: neither the FS page nor rec.gov carries any 'trailers/RVs not recommended' or high-clearance wording; the stored note's 'Narrow/steep access road -- fine for 23 ft, not big rigs' has no source on either page and was removed from the note. Sites are 27-66 ft long (site length, no vehicle limit published); no criteria problem found.
WATER: FS says 'Potable water is not available at this site'; rec.gov says 'Drinking water available at the center of the campground' - conflict, potable_water left unwritten.
SEASON: FS 2026 05-05 to 10-24 vs rec.gov 2026 05-05 to 10-28; rec.gov's 2027 season 05-07 to 10-24 written (lesson: FS and rec.gov disagree -> rec.gov).

Phone 423-638-4109 confirmed (rec.gov). Pin 35.97840,-82.84451 vs RV-site centroid ~35.9779,-82.8440 (~60 m) - fine. Websites (FS r08 page + rec.gov) unchanged. Agency name 'Paint Creek Campground' (stored 'Paint Creek') - optional.
